thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired: PD-48721 — instance group 'inference-eu' elevated 5xx rate > 5% for 3m. Auto-escalation in 2m if unacked. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-48721

pagerduty: Incident PD-48721 triggered by monitoring rule 'inference-5xx-rate'. Service: redwood-inference-hosted. Impact: elevated 5xx returning to customers (generation failures).

alex murphy: acked. I'm on it — jumping into logs and load metrics.

samir patel: thanks. grabbing the dashboard — looks like spike from a single model shard.

alex murphy: verified. 95th latency okay, but 5xxs originate from node gpu-03-eu with `cuda OOM` pattern in logs.

maria chen: @alex do we want a failover to dedicated pool or restart the node?

alex murphy: quick plan: 1) remove node from LB to stop new requests 2) trigger rolling restart 3) reroute traffic to warm spare pool (inference-eu-spare) 4) monitor 5xx rate and client errors.

samir patel: removing node from LB now: 
```
# cordon and drain
kubectl cordon gpu-03-eu -n inference
kubectl drain gpu-03-eu -n inference --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

oncall-bot: Node gpu-03-eu removed from service by samir patel.

alex murphy: triggering restart on that host (running `systemctl restart redwood-inference`), also increasing routing weight to inference-eu-spare by 30%.

pagerduty: PD-48721 acknowledged by alex murphy. Status: investigating.

maria chen: rolling restart completed on gpu-03-eu. Post-restart logs show no immediate OOMs but some degraded throughput while caches refill.

samir patel: bumped spare pool to handle extra capacity: 
```
POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/pools/inference-eu-spare/scale
{ "delta_instances": 4 }
```

oncall-bot: Autoscaler request acknowledged, 4 instances requested; expected ready in ~90s.

alex murphy: observing 5xx rate trending down from 6.1% -> 1.2% in the last 3 minutes. Good sign. Keeping PD open until stable for 10m.

sre-lead: thanks for the quick action. Any customers hit with critical SLAs?

maria chen: preliminary list: 3 customers in EU with higher error volumes; support already notified with templated message and ETA. No enterprise SLA breach expected if rate stays <2%.

alex murphy: adding a temporary routing rule to prefer dedicated pools for high-priority tenants to reduce customer impact: 
```
route add --service inference --match "tenant in (acme, dataloft)" --to inference-dedicated-eu
```

oncall-bot: Routing rule applied by alex murphy.

samir patel: health checks passing on scaled spare pool, new instances ready. 5xx now at 0.6% over 2m window.

alex murphy: marking incident as mitigated. Plan: keep extra capacity for 30m, then gradually scale down; run a deeper postmortem tomorrow to check model memory usage across shards.

pagerduty: PD-48721 status changed to 'Mitigated' by alex murphy.

sre-lead: assign follow-up owner for postmortem and action items. @maria can you take the postmortem (writeup + remediation: pod memory limits, kernel setting) and coordinate with research?

maria chen: taking postmortem ownership. I'll ping infra and research for model mem profiling. ETA for draft: EOD tomorrow.

alex murphy: quick handoff for next on-call window: summary for @maria — OOMs on gpu-03-eu caused 5xx spike, mitigated by draining node + scaling spare pool + routing high-priority tenants to dedicated pool. Watch: 5xx rate, gpu memory metrics, and autoscaler queue.

maria chen: acked handoff. I'll run next checks at +15m and +45m.

oncall-bot: Incident PD-48721 closed by alex murphy at 1779001734.

samir patel: nice work team :thumbsup:

maria chen: thanks everyone. I'll post postmortem link when ready. :eyes:
